description: Returns the full schema of a single Connect REST endpoint: method, path, parameters (query/body/header) with types, authentication, response statuses and bodies, response headers, per-provider behavior, notes, and examples. Resolve by endpointId (from listConnectEndpoints) or by method + path (a full URL or a path with /api works too; a path alone that matches several methods returns the candidates). Describes the endpoint from documentation; does not call it. Documents the Mobiscroll Connect REST API: https://mobiscroll.com/docs/connect/api/overview

method.description: HTTP method, e.g. "GET". Use with path if endpointId is unknown.

path.description: Endpoint path, e.g. "/events" (relative to the API base; "/api/events" or a full URL also work).

name: getConnectEndpointSchema
title: Get Connect Endpoint Schema
